Name: Secretariat (Faster Horse)
Author: Janglinator
Description:
The horse is far too slow in vanilla, I felt a speed increase for an existing paid item was fair.  The existing "Faster Horse" mod is buggy.  No other mods existed with a decent horse-only speed increase (that didn't require constantly feeding the horse), so I made one.

To adjust speed increase, simply run the mod once, then edit the `config.json` in the mod's directory.

Source is available on [url=https://github.com/Janglinator/Secretariat]Github[/url]

Downloads.Description: Updated manifest for SMAPI to check for updates
